# OmniRoute with Codex

> Local-first Grok compatibility bridge for Codex and OmniRoute. Windows supports supervised sign-in startup; the Node.js core can run manually elsewhere.

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [AI-guided installation](docs/ai-install.md)
- [Install manifest](install-manifest.json)
- [Human user guide](docs/user-guide.md)
- [Windows setup](docs/setup-windows.md)
- [Configuration and profiles](docs/configuration.md)
- [Recovery and rollback](docs/recovery.md)
- [Security](SECURITY.md)

OmniRoute is a separate running prerequisite. No API keys or provider credentials are included. Setup previews by default; `--apply` is required for mutations. A real client/tool-continuation check and a destination reboot remain separate acceptance steps.
